narrative.overview:
A printed countryside menu laid on a parchment table. One ivory sheet sits on a dotted warm wash; wheat, fence, mill, and roof motifs appear only as cropped edge fragments. Guests read Landar's Food dishes, prices, fillings, and allergens at the festival counter. They do not shop.

The voice is editorial and quiet. Condensed Britannic names the menu and the food; Gilroy carries everything you scan in a hurry. Depth is three papers and thin beige rules, not glow or catalogue chrome. This file records the `/festival-menu/` surface as built — local `Landars Britannic` (TTF) and `Landars Gilroy` (woff2) in `frontend-marketplace/public/fonts`. Marketplace shop chrome is a different world and is hidden here.
keyCharacteristics: Three paper layers: parchment canvas, ivory sheet, cream cards
Britannic condensed uppercase for menu, sections, and dish names; Gilroy for the rest
5:4 photo wells; labeled **Photo unavailable** when the image is missing or broken
Filling choices nested inside the parent card
Browse-only public catalogue: marketplace header and footer off; festival footer is a counter note

rules.name: The Three-Paper Rule
rules.body: Depth is parchment → ivory sheet → card cream. Do not collapse them into one fill.

rules.name: The Harvest-Rarity Rule
rules.body: Harvest gold marks money and the meal-offer hairline. It is not a surface.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Britannic condensed uppercase names the menu, sections, and dishes. Gilroy carries body, labels, navigation, and prices. Never set a price in Britannic.

rules.name: The Sheet-in-Frame Rule
rules.body: Copy and cards live on the ivory sheet. Countryside linework occupies only the side rails, cropped as edge fragments, and a village horizon in the festival footer.

rules.name: The Nested-Choice Rule
rules.body: Filling variants stay inside the parent product card as a ruled list. They are not sibling product cards.

rules.name: The Paper-Lift Rule
rules.body: Cards and states rest on a 1px beige stroke plus the card wash. Shadows stay brown and diffuse. They are not a hover gimmick.

rules.name: The Ruled-Band Rule
rules.body: Meal offers and category add-ons are transparent bands between beige rules, not filled banners.

dos: Do keep photo wells at 5:4. If the photo is missing or broken, keep the well and label it **Photo unavailable**.
Do always render Ingredients and Allergens; use **Not listed** when the API string is empty.
Do nest filling choices inside the parent card under a “Choose your …” label.
Do hide the marketplace Header and Footer on `/festival-menu/`; end the sheet with the village horizon and the counter note.
Do load Britannic and Gilroy from `/fonts` (TTF + woff2). Treat `/festival-menu/` as a public browse-only catalogue.
donts: Don't add cart, checkout, account, or other ecommerce chrome to this surface.
Don't promote fillings into their own product cards or a separate option-group tile.
Don't drop village motifs into the reading column or overlay badges on food photos.
Don't invent a primary purchase button. Retry exists only when the menu fails to load.
Don't fill offer or add-on bands with a tinted promo background.
